LocalStack for Azure Enters Public Preview with Security Settings Stored but Not Enforced
items.blurb: LocalStack has opened its Azure emulator to a free public preview, running Azure services locally and accepting existing ARM, Bicep, and Terraform without rewrites.

items.title: Google Discloses PageBreak AI Security Agent That Found 500+ XSS Bugs
items.blurb: According to a paper published by Google, its AI-powered security agent has uncovered more than 500 XSS vulnerabilities across its web applications since entering full operation in January.
